facts.fact: AlgerieZoom reports that the DGI's Jibayatic tele-declaration and tele-payment system, in which only large-enterprise (DGE) taxpayers were previously required to file electronically, is generalised to all local tax structures under DGI instruction 31/2026 of 6 May 2026.
AlgerieZoom reports that taxpayers of tax centres, proximity centres and inspections can pay taxes remotely through Jibayatic for the first time, as an optional method.

AlgerieZoom reports that electronic filing is mandatory for DGE taxpayers and, under instruction 31/2026, for real-profit regime and simplified non-commercial-profession taxpayers, though 2025 returns other than series G n°50 may still be filed on paper.
